title: Remittance Periods, Clearance Holdback and Minimum Remittance under the Contingency Placement Agreements
content:
Collections held in trust under the Contingency Placement Agreements are remitted to the creditor client per remittance period of the agreement's remittance frequency.

## Remittance periods

| Remittance frequency | Remittance periods |
|---|---|
| Weekly | Monday through Sunday |
| Semi-monthly | the 1st to the 15th, and the 16th to the month end |
| Monthly | calendar months |

The remittance is sent within the tier's sending period, in business days after the period ends.

## What is remitted

- **Cleared funds only.** Only cleared funds are remitted: collections received in the last clearance-holdback business days of a period (the tier's clearance holdback) roll into the next period.
- **Gross remittance.** For a gross-remittance agreement the whole period's collections are remitted and the fees are invoiced.
- **Net remittance — retired clause.** The clause "for a net-remittance agreement the period's fees are first retained from trust and the rest is remitted" is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis on which the trust balance of a net-remittance agreement is set against the fees owed.
- **Minimum.** When the amount to remit is below the tier's minimum remittance it is carried to the next period.
- **Negative period.** When reversals exceed collections in a period, the shortfall is carried against the next period where the tier's handling is carry-forward, and invoiced to the client where it is invoice.

## One remittance per period

Each remittance period is remitted once, with its own statement. Whether a period has already been remitted is read from the agreement's client money history for that agreement and that remittance period.

## Hypothetical cases

| Situation | Result |
|---|---|
| Semi-monthly agreement; collection received on the 9th, outside the holdback days | remitted with the 1st–15th period |
| Collection received within the last holdback business days of a period | rolls into the next period |
| Amount to remit below the tier minimum | carried to the next period |
| Reversals exceed collections; tier handling is carry-forward | shortfall carried against the next period |
| Reversals exceed collections; tier handling is invoice | shortfall invoiced to the client |
| A remittance has already been issued for the same agreement and period | no second remittance for that period |

superseded_clauses: For a net_remit agreement the period's fees are first retained from trust and the rest is remitted
